name: Target Food Distribution Center Lake City

fieldNotes.location: Geocoded point (30.44245,-82.646011) was ~28 km too far north in open forest. Real facility resolved via Wikimedia geocoords (30.2312N, 82.6383W) + Target bullseye sign confirmed in 2026 Street View at the entrance. Center 30.2318,-82.6360, NE Lake City just SW of I-75/US-441.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance: divided entry/exit drive with chevron-striped median, painted stop bar, and a small canopy/checkpoint structure at the yard-entry pinch point (~30.2312,-82.6345). Whole parcel is chain-link fenced (confirmed in Street View).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly-resolved staffed booth. The interior checkpoint shows only a small canopy/structure at z21 — could be an unmanned kiosk canopy; imagery is borderline, hence remoteGs assumed.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Assumed because there is a controlled gate/checkpoint but no definitively manned guard shack; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court between the interior checkpoint and the dock aprons holds queuing trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 460,000 sq ft refrigerated DC; long west dock wall plus east and south dock banks with dozens of trailers backed in across multiple faces — clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large arrays of trailers parked in marked rows along the west apron and east side; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on the west wall and the east/south faces suggest separate ship/receive clusters; inferred, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided entry apron with ample paved width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale pad clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / rural setting — surrounded by woods, retention pond, and scattered rural residential along US-441.
fieldNotes.counts: dockDoorCount/trailers are honest overhead estimates from z16-z21 imagery, not exact.

citations.claim: Active Target Operations Manager req at the Food Distribution Center, 3049 North US-441, Lake City FL 32055 — exact audited address.
